name: Evidence Distinction Policy
guidance: Always distinguish facts in the code from assumptions. Cite exact line numbers.

name: GitHub Copilot Provider Steering
directive: Model-provider integrations using GitHub Copilot MUST use the device-flow or managed API key only; persist tokens only in the project cache directory; requests must include required editor headers and only target allowed endpoints (https://api.githubcopilot.com and https://api.github.com). Tooling MUST never auto-execute destructive file operations without explicit Owner sign-off. Logging MUST redact tokens and API keys.
